name: truthstone
description: Truthstone (previously named AgentGuard) is a local, deterministic reliability layer for Claude Code: its hooks check the request against your repository, send irreversible or destructive commands back to you for review, and hold a "done" that the recorded test evidence contradicts. Inside git repositories only, it reads prompts and edit, shell and MCP tool calls on your machine, keeps a local log, never grants permissions and sends no telemetry. The first session downloads its runtime with uv from GitHub (opt out with TRUTHSTONE_NO_BOOTSTRAP=1).
